Real AlphaFold DB models used as regression fixtures:

- `AF-P69905-F1-model_v6.pdb`: human hemoglobin subunit alpha
- `AF-P04637-F1-model_v6.pdb`: human cellular tumor antigen p53

Source: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk),
Jumper et al., Nature 2021; Varadi et al., Nucleic Acids Research 2024.
